about: Three small instances (Appendix A.6, Supplementary S4): the network bound T1 and its tightened form T1' computed by hand (hand_values, in the order of the document: corridor T1, T1', crossroads T1, T1', consecutive tasks T1, T1', T1' rewritten), and the throughput (moves per 16-h day) simulated on the same instances by free flow, full-path reservation and the reference rule (stepwise requests, deadlocks resolved by teleporting after 900 s).
